flags.evidence: Opened page/index.html from disk in Chromium at 1440x900 (and 390x844 @3x). The most prominent first-screen action at 1440 is the filled 244x51 button 'Send me alerts for my street' (top 725px, inside the 900px fold); the header 'Get alerts for your street' (href #signup) is its repeat. Before clicking, the only text around the form is the labels 'Your neighbourhood', 'Email address', the Spanish checkbox and the fineprint 'Free. At most one email per meeting. Reply "stop" to stop.' Nothing says the button opens an email app or that nothing is sent. Chose 'Oakdale', typed resident@example.com, clicked: the page requested mailto:alerts@commonread.org?subject=Alerts%20for%20Oakdale&body=Please%20add%20me... (script.js sets window.location.href), and only afterwards #signup-done appeared: 'Almost there. Your email app should have opened...'. Same result at 390. The brief supplies no email address, so the primary action goes to an email address the brief did not supply; the 'stated before the visitor commits' exception does not apply because the mailto behaviour is disclosed only after the click.

At 1440 and 390 (@3x), the #how intro reads 'Here is one real item from the October 28 agenda, next to the summary we sent', with the summary status 'Checked against the original by Dana R. (volunteer), Oct 24' and list items 'Checked by Luis M.' / 'Checked by Priya S.'; the 'For city clerks and funders: where we are' table states 'City: Linden Falls (one city so far)' and 'Meetings covered: Every regular council meeting since September 2026'; agenda/2026-10-28-item-7b.html's top bar says 'A copy of the city's posted agenda, kept by Commonread for the pilot.' The brief names no pilot city, no coverage history and says there are no usage numbers to show; the 'Meetings covered' row is an invented track-record/usage claim presented as fact in the proof section aimed at clerks and funders, and the 'real item... summary we sent' framing presents the invented agenda and volunteer sign-offs as actual output. Searched body text for sample/example/illustrative/demo: the only hit is 'a sample of corrected summaries' in the clerks contact line, so no sample label sits next to this content at 390 (the hero alert card's caption 'What an alert looks like' does not cover #how or #clerks). Not covered by the brief-facts or labelled-sample exceptions.
